label: Article Structure & Drafting
description: Structure and draft news articles, features, long-form investigations, and opinion pieces. Develop compelling leads, logical structures, and strong endings.

modelTier.notes: Haiku for short news items. Sonnet for features and investigations. Opus for complex long-form narratives.

guidedInputs.label: Story Summary
guidedInputs.description: What is the story? Summarise it in 2-3 sentences as you'd tell it to a colleague.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. A major bank has been fined €150m for AML failures spanning 5 years. The regulator found that risk alerts were systematically dismissed by middle management. Three executives have resigned.

guidedInputs.label: Article Type
guidedInputs.description: What type of article is this?

guidedInputs.label: Target Audience & Publication
guidedInputs.description: Who reads this? What publication/platform is this for?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Financial Times readers — senior finance professionals. Reuters wire — global, technically informed.

guidedInputs.label: Key Facts, Quotes & Data
guidedInputs.description: Paste the key facts, statistics, quotes, and evidence to be included.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. €150m fine (largest in jurisdiction history). 5-year period 2018-2023. 3,400 suspicious activity reports dismissed without investigation. Quote: CEO says 'systemic failure'. Regulator: 'culture of non-compliance'.
